MODULE.name: Fingerprint
MODULE.HELP_OVERVIEW: API to authenticate using fingerprint sensor
MODULE.MORE_HELP: API works for only Android and iOS platforms. Include 'fingerprint' in the extensions property of build.yml to use the extension. Can be called using Rho::Fingerprint.enableFingerprintScan(CallBackHandler callback)

PROPERTIES.DESC: list of properties supported by instance of object

METHOD.name: enableFingerprintScan
METHOD.DESC: Attach event listener to fingerprint sensor for authentication

CALLBACK.DESC: authStatus returns boolean value stating the result of authentication. statusMessage provides verbose message stating the result of authentication.
